name: Data Lakehouse
tagline: A local demo of a Modern Data Stack (MDS)
valueProposition: This production-grade Data Lakehouse integrates disparate data sources into a single, high-integrity analytical platform. Combining a Medallion Architecture and Star Schema design, the system transforms raw multi-source JSON into sophisticated Gold-layer tables. The data model uses fact tables for match events, and SCD Type 2 dimensions to track temporal changes in player market values and injury status. Following industry best practices, the implementation leverages scheduled maintenance routines as well as advanced table optimisations.

animations.description: Visualisation of the backpressure handling mechanism during peak traffic spikes.
Dynamic DAG generation logic for multi-tenant data transformation jobs.

name: MLOps
tagline: A local demo of a production-grade MLOps platform
valueProposition: A production-grade MLOps showcase that prioritizes architectural simplicity and statistical interpretability. It replaces standard 'black-box' classification with a Poisson-distributed Latent Strength Model, enabling high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations for football match forecasting while maintaining a local-first, containerized developer experience.

animations.description: Senior-Grade Developer Experience (DX): Highlight your Makefile. A senior engineer cares about how easily another teammate can spin up the environment. Show the entire stack (DuckDB, MLflow, Streamlit) launching with one command.

The "Point-in-Time" Join (Engineering Rigor): Demonstrate your SQL/DuckDB logic that ensures the model only "sees" team strengths as they existed before a match kicked off. This highlights a sophisticated understanding of temporal features that junior devs often miss.

The "Local Feature Store" Pattern (Architectural Design): Show how you’ve separated raw data ingestion from feature engineering using DuckDB. This highlights your ability to design systems that are modular and easy to migrate to cloud environments (like Snowflake/Databricks).

name: Stream Processing
tagline: A local demo of an architecture for event-driven streaming and real-time insights
useCase: Monitoring web browser activity for performance and security insights
valueProposition: A high-throughput, local-first streaming architecture for browser resource telemetry. It implements a 'Kappa' architecture using the Chrome DevTools Protocol, Redpanda, and DuckDB to provide real-time, privacy-preserving insights into memory, network, and lifecycle performance without the overhead of traditional polling.

name: GenAI
tagline: A Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system for contextual LLM responses
useCase: Source code analysis and vulnerability detection
valueProposition: This LLM-augmented code analysis system moves beyond traditional static analysis to perform structural reasoning on source code. By transforming raw code into a multidimensional Code Property Graph (CPG), the system enables a local LLM to query the codebase's contents. This allows for the automated detection of anti-patterns related to architecture, testing and security.
